$comment: DevRites hooks — auto-approve the read-only orientation/gate scripts (no more per-run permission prompts), inject the active feature's orientation at session start, and arm the A1 pre-block guard (devrites-a1-guard.sh) on Edit/Write. The guard is OBSERVE-only by default (it logs but never blocks); enable enforcement with DEVRITES_A1_HOOK=enforce or a .devrites/work/<slug>/.a1-enforce file once the .a1-guard.log confirms it never flags the wright's own edits. The bash installer SEEDS this file only when .claude/settings.json is absent; it is never overwritten on update, so your own settings are safe to add here. Plugin installs get the same hooks via pack/.claude/hooks/hooks.json instead.
